english: Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away.
text: 这句不说 People often cause forest fires...，而用 are often caused by，是因为话题焦点在“森林火灾的起因”，不在谁引发的。讲一类现象的常见原因时，把现象放句首当主语，用被动引出原因，话题更连贯，重点也对。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
